info.name: F5 XC - Vuln-Bank Setup
info.description:
Postman collection for managing Namespaces in F5 Distributed Cloud (XC).

API Reference: https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/namespace

## Setup
Set the following collection variables before use:
- `xc_tenant` — your tenant name (e.g. `mycompany`)
- `xc_api_token` — your F5 XC API token (from Console > Administration > Credentials)
